stem:
A factory owner models the number of employees who use the factory canteen on any day by the distribution $\text{B}(25, p)$. In the past the value of $p$ was 0.8. A new menu is introduced in the canteen and the owner wants to test whether the value of $p$ has increased.

On a randomly chosen day he notes that the number of employees who use the canteen is 23.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Use the binomial distribution to carry out the test at the 10% significance level.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Given that there are 30 employees at the factory comment on the suitability of the owner’s model.
